description: Golden fingerprints of public-only v2 outputs, frozen so that additive v3 work cannot silently change the v2 scoring path. Scores are rounded to GOLDEN_DECIMALS places before fingerprinting; see tests/test_v2_golden.py. Private query outputs are intentionally excluded.
reanchor_note: Re-recorded after the fingerprint was made host-independent. The original digest hashed full-precision floats, so it reproduced only on the machine that captured it: with identical data bytes and identical pinned dependencies, two Linux hosts produced different digests because vectorized floating-point operations differ in their final bits. Before re-recording, the v2 outputs were recomputed at 1f6173c, the commit that froze this golden, and at 61fc130; both produced byte-identical results, so the v2 scoring path did not change between them and the freeze is intact. The reference-coverage digest is unaffected by rounding and is unchanged from the original capture at 2ed4684.
